propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center because it only supports Cloud, which uses REST v3 + ADF, PAT bearer auth via ACLI subprocess, and accountId-based user identity
DC differs from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 with wiki-markup/plain-text bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity instead of accountId
existing duplicate field maps and sanitizers across jira_fields.py and outbound_fields.py must be consolidated into a single jira_family shared layer without forking the Cloud adapter
location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) loaded by file path cannot physically move without breaking the dynamic loader, but can be parameterized by contracts
RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel contracts enable Cloud (ADF + accountId) and DC (wiki/plain-text + name) to reuse shared field-mapping logic without implementation duplication
